system.description:
Makeshift armor made with irradiated metal plating, dangerous to living creatures nearby.

Special: When a melee attack is made against a location fitted with toxic plate, and the attacker suffers a complication, then the attacker suffers 2 @fos[DC] Radiation damage. In addition, melee attacks made using arms fitted with serrated plate gain the Radioactive damage effect.
